train_vocoder_step: train a GAN-based vocoder model for one step using a batch of audio data
eval_vocoder_step: evaluate a GAN-based vocoder model on a single batch without computing gradients
init_vocoder_trainer: initialize a vocoder trainer with steps, epochs, data loader, model, criterion, optimizer, and config
review_trainer_class: review the Trainer class that extends TrainerGAN for GAN-based vocoder training flow
refactor_train_step: refactor the _train_step method to customize generator and discriminator training logic
